n: Count the Dots binary numbers (CS Unplugged)
t: Dot cards teach students how computers store numbers with 0s and 1s.
steps: Find the Binary numbers topic on the CS Unplugged site.
Choose the junior or older lesson.
Print one demonstration set of binary cards.
Print Binary Windows for each student.
Print small cards for pairs and a number line from 0 to 20.
Practice showing and hiding the cards yourself.
Teach the 45 minute junior lesson with volunteers at the front.
